# Now 2.11.5
- The full-screen view now has a living, Apple-Music-style background: soft color blobs sampled from the album art drift slowly behind the lyrics, replacing the static blurred cover. Colors cross-fade smoothly when the track changes.

# Now 2.11.4
- Fixed a glitch where a word in a wrapped (two-line) lyric would jump between rows as the line became active and snap back afterward. All lines now use one weight and highlight purely by brightness, like Apple Music, so the text no longer re-wraps. - Smoother full-screen lyric scrolling: removed the per-line blur and switched to eager rendering so lines no longer hitch as they're created mid-scroll. Animations run at the display's native refresh rate (including 120 Hz / 100 Hz).

# Now 2.11.3
- Full-screen lyrics now size themselves to the screen so about eight lines are visible at once — matching Apple Music — instead of the line count and font drifting with display size. - Larger, more generously spaced lyric type and a slightly larger album art in the full-screen view for a closer match to Apple Music. - The native window buttons (close / minimize / zoom) now slide down from the top of the full-screen view when you move the pointer up, so you can close or minimize without pressing Escape. The red button still exits cleanly and leaves the desktop overlay running.
